data.name: Cowgirl 45' Premium Offshore Fishing Charter
data.headline: Private offshore fishing aboard the 45’ Cowgirl with cold A/C, a smooth ride, and comfortable, family-friendly deep-sea fishing in Key West.
data.description:
Step aboard Cowgirl, our 45’ Hatteras offshore sportfishing boat built for comfort, stability, and serious fishing. This private Key West offshore fishing charter is perfect for families, groups, and anglers of all experience levels.
You can fish reefs, wrecks, and deep water for mahi, wahoo, tuna, sailfish, snapper, and shark. Our crew is professional and family-friendly. Enjoy a smooth ride and relax in a cold, air-conditioned cabin between bites.
Trip Details
Private charter for up to 6 guests
4, 6, 8, 10, or 12-hour trips available
Quality tackle, bait, licenses, ice, and fish cleaning included
Bring your own food and drinks

highlight_box.title: Comfortable Private Offshore Fishing
highlight_box.description: Enjoy fishing in comfort on the 45’ Cowgirl. It has cold A/C and a smooth ride. Experience a private, family-friendly deep-sea fishing trip in Key West.

data.highlights:
Flagship offshore performance.
Cowgirl is a 45’ Hatteras built for stability, power, and bluewater fishing. She has earned tournament wins over the years and is a longstanding, well-known offshore fishing boat in Key West.
Serious fishing for every experience level.
From first-time anglers to seasoned fishermen, our captain and mate tailor the trip to your group. Expect opportunities for mahi, wahoo, tuna, sailfish, snapper, shark, and more across offshore reefs, wrecks, and deep water.
Comfort that matters offshore.
Enjoy a smooth ride, shaded areas, and a cool, air-conditioned cabin. This private charter is perfect for families and groups who want comfort and real offshore fun.
Everything you need, handled professionally.
We provide quality tackle, bait, fishing licenses, ice, and fish cleaning. We keep legal, edible fish as you request. We practice catch-and-release for non-edible, illegal, or unwanted species.
data.itinerary:
Arrival & Check-In
Arrive 15 minutes early. You’ll receive a text the night before with exact meeting details. Look for our dock sign behind the boat.
Boarding & Setup
Load your food and drinks, stow gear, and get comfortable. Bottled water is provided onboard.
Safety Brief & Fishing Plan
Meet your captain and mate, review safety procedures, sea conditions, and discuss target species and fishing techniques.
Departure
Typical departure times are 7:00 AM or 1:00 PM, with flexibility available by request.
Run Offshore
Cruise to offshore reefs, wrecks, or deep water while the crew prepares the gear and sets up for fishing.
Fishing Time
Lines go in and the action begins. Anglers rotate on strikes, and beginners receive hands-on coaching from the crew.
Comfort Breaks
Relax between bites in the cold, air-conditioned cabin or shaded cockpit.
Return to Dock
Enjoy a safe cruise back to the marina with time for photos and stories from the day.
Fish Cleaning
The mate cleans and bags your legal catch at the dock and can recommend local restaurants to prepare it.

data.cancellation_notes:
For **private charters**, we kindly request a 7 day notice. Trip protection is available for an additional fee. If trip protection is purchased you can cancel up to 12 hours prior to departure for a full refund minus the TP & booking fee. 

For **shared charters**, we kindly request a 7 day notice. Trip protection is available for an additional fee. If trip protection is purchased you can cancel up to 2 hours prior to departure for a full refund minus the TP & booking fee. 
 
❌ ** Non-Refundable Bookings** Reservations made within 24 hours of departure are non-refundable. However, we always strive to accommodate changes when possible.
 
🔄  **Rescheduling Option**  If you must cancel with less than 7 day notice, don't worry! You'll have the opportunity to reschedule your fishing adventure, for a small rescheduling fee.
 
❌ ** No Show Policy**  A "no show" without prior notice will result in forfeiture of your fare. We understand that unexpected situations arise, but hangovers, oversleeping, walking off at departure time, or any other reasons not mentioned are ineligible for a refund.
 
🛑 **Cancellations by us** If we ever have to cancel the trip for any reason, such as adverse weather or mechanical issues, you will receive a FULL REFUND. Your satisfaction is our priority. We will do our best to reschedule you on another vessel or a different day/time.
 
📞 ** Prompt Communication**  If you need to cancel or reschedule, please **text** us immediately at 305-304-2946. We'll do our best to accommodate your needs.
 
⚠️ ** Seasickness Consideration**  Seasickness happens occasionally and is not a refundable situation. We encourage guests to take necessary precautions for a comfortable trip.
 
Your trust in Cowboy-Cowgirl Sportfishing means the world to us, and we're committed to providing you with a fun and enjoyable fishing experience. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out.

data.restrictions:
Restrictions
Guests of all ages and experience levels are welcome. Please inform the captain and mate before departure of any medical conditions, disabilities, mobility limitations, or other concerns that may require additional assistance onboard. This allows the crew to ensure a safe and comfortable experience for everyone.
data.extras: No additional add-ons are required for this trip.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
Health & Safety Notes
Required medical disclosure (guest responsibility): Guests must tell the captain about any medical conditions before departure. This includes pregnancy, back or neck injuries, heart issues, recent surgery, seizure disorders, severe allergies, and mobility limitations. This allows the captain to plan the trip safely and appropriately.
The captain is in charge.
This is for everyone's safety.
The captain's decisions about participation, the schedule, weather, and sea conditions are final. Failure to disclose relevant conditions may result in modified activities or being unable to participate.
Seasickness: If prone, take medication the night before and again in the morning (per label). Eat a light, non-greasy meal and hydrate.
Footwear & sun: Wear non-marking, non-slip shoes and use reef-safe sunscreen, hats, and UV layers. Bottled water is provided.
Alcohol: Adult beverages welcome in moderation; service may be curtailed for safety.
Kids & gear: Children must be closely supervised. Coast Guard–approved safety equipment is on board; life jackets available for all ages.
On-deck awareness & fish handling: Use handholds, watch hooks/knives, follow crew instructions, and no running. Non-eating species and anything not legal are released.
data.disclaimers:
Disclaimers
Fishing depends on the weather and conditions. Trip routes, target species, and fishing success can change. These changes may happen due to weather, sea conditions, or safety concerns. The captain reserves the right to modify or cancel trips if conditions are deemed unsafe. All fishing is subject to current regulations and seasonal availability.
data.faqs:
-What times do trips depart?
Standard departures are 7:00 AM and 1:00 PM. Alternate times may be available by request.
-When should we arrive and where do we meet?
Please arrive 15 minutes early. You’ll receive a text the night before with exact meeting details. Look for our dock sign behind the boat.
-How many people can go?
Up to 6 guests (USCG limit).
-What’s included in the price?
All bait, tackle, rods, reels, and fishing licenses are included. Ice and fish cleaning are also provided. You will enjoy a cold, comfortable cabin with air conditioning.
-What should we bring?
Please bring the following items:


Food and drinks (adult beverages are welcome)
Sun protection
Non-marking or non-slip shoes
A camera or phone
Completed digital waivers
-Are food and drinks provided?
Bottled water is provided. Please bring any additional snacks or beverages you’d like.
-Can we drink alcohol onboard?
Yes, adult beverages are welcome. Please drink responsibly.
-Do you allow kids and beginners?
Absolutely. This is a family-friendly charter, and our crew provides hands-on coaching for beginners.
-What can we catch, and can we keep fish?
Target species include mahi, wahoo, tuna, sailfish, snapper, shark, and more (season and conditions vary). Legal, edible fish may be kept at your request. Catch-and-release is practiced for non-edible, non-legal, or unwanted fish.
-Who cleans the fish?
The mate cleans and bags your legal catch and can recommend local restaurants that will prepare it.
=How long is the ride to the fishing grounds?
Travel time varies based on conditions and trip length. -Your captain balances run time and fishing time for the best possible action.
-What if the weather looks bad?
Weather decisions are made late the night before or early the morning of your trip. If conditions are unsafe, we’ll reschedule or refund according to policy.
-I get seasick — any tips?
If you are prone to motion sickness, take medication the night before your trip. Take it again in the morning, following the label instructions. Stay hydrated and wear non-slip shoes.
-Do I need to sign anything?
Yes. All guests must complete digital waivers prior to arrival to speed up boarding.
-Are there any medical or mobility restrictions?
Guests with medical conditions, disabilities, or mobility limitations must inform the captain before departure. Guests should be able to step from dock to boat and move safely on a rocking deck. Final suitability is at the captain’s discretion.
-How do gratuities work?
Gratuity for the mate is customary and greatly appreciated. 
Industry standard is 15–20% based on service.
